dominant_strengths: Color-coded left accent bars on toasts give clear semantic differentiation between info and success states
Restrained dark palette with muted neutrals lets colored accents carry meaning without visual noise
Typographic hierarchy inside toasts (bold title, secondary description) reads cleanly and predictably
dominant_weaknesses: Notifications are pinned to bottom-right while the trigger buttons sit dead-center, breaking spatial relationship
The 'Notifications' header feels orphaned and ghostly low-contrast, undermining page identity and rhythm
Toasts are visually generic — borders, icons, and progress bars feel like a default Sonner/Radix template
fix_priorities: Tighten composition: anchor triggers near a related anchor or move toasts to relate to invocation source
Strengthen header treatment with clearer contrast, scale, or supporting metadata to ground the page
Differentiate toast craft via custom iconography, refined timing bars, or subtler border treatments
Add motion specification cues (stack offset, enter/exit easing) to elevate perceived polish
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity is decent thanks to semantic color, but visceral impact and reflective memorability are weak due to template-feeling execution.
rationale.intent_fit: It satisfies the literal brief of stacked notifications but contributes little novel beyond a stock toast library appearance.
